d:
Al-Qadsiah claimed the top spot in the Saudi Pro League in dramatic fashion, beating Al-Taawoun 1-0 on Matchday 10.
In a tight match, Al-Taawoun defended stoutly for 95 minutes, but Tijjani Reijnders proved the hero, scoring the winner in the 96th minute. The late breakthrough dashed Al-Taawoun's hopes of snatching a point and propelled Al-Qadsiah to 25 points at the summit of the table, while keeping Al-Taawoun in 17th place with four points.
